notes.title: The SPANISH update - Lof-Ely: The Dark Cave Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
The game now has a new language in which it can be played, the beautiful language of the Hispanic world. My language in fact c:

 Added the Option to play the game in Spanish.
 Fixed several bugs.
 Changed the name of FPS Synch. And fixed performance issues that caused several crashes.
 Added some secret stuff.


Keep your eyes open for another, especially significant update soon. For now, if you speak Spanish, disfruta del juego!

notes.title: Lof-Ely: The Dark Cave Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Again nothing major, just a few fixes and a new sprite.


Fixed a few typos in various dialogues across the game, mainly in the latter zones.
Added a Sprite for an optional event on the 11th Floor.
Fixed a few typos on some images.
Fixed a bunch of significant bugs in the 8th, 10th, 11th Floor and 13th floor.

Keep your eyes open for a more significant update soon, especially if you speak Spanish.

notes.title: Lof-Ely: The Dark Cave Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Fixed a few typos in various dialogues across the game, mainly in the first zones.
 Fixed some bugs in Floor 8, The Ice maze zone, Floor 10, the dessert zone, and a few smaller bugs in the prior areas.

Keep your eyes open for a more significant update soon.

notes.title: Lof- Ely: The Dark Cave Update 1.0.1
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with one of the plugins, that did not work properly and thus did not allow the player to earn achievements.
